jobs.title: Associate Director, Process & Platform
jobs.description:
At M\&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  

  

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.  

  

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.  

  

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

 **Associate Director, Process \& Platform**

  

Corporate Pension Solutions (CPS) is a division within M\&G Life with a remit to design and deliver bulk purchase annuities and alternative de\-risking products for Defined Benefit pension schemes. Due to ongoing success, a strong opportunity set, and ambitious growth plans, the team is adding headcount in a number of areas.

  

We’re looking for an exceptional individual to enable M\&G’s Digital Strategy, using technological and actuarial expertise to develop areas within the pricing platform and end\-to\-end new business processes as CPS accelerates its growth plans.

  

The Associate Director, Process \& Platform leads the development of pricing systems, models and business processes that underpin Corporate Pension Solutions' growth strategy. The role brings together actuarial, technology and process expertise to improve operational efficiency, enhance platform capabilities and deliver scalable solutions for new business pricing.

 **Key Responsibilities for this role:**

  

* Support for and ownership of some tools, systems and model infrastructure across pricing and associated workstreams, such as liability cashflow engine, capital projection model, integrated data management, asset portfolio construction and/or financial reporting reconciliation
* Support the design and enable the build and delivery of short, medium and long term strategy for responsible models in partnership with stakeholders across Life, Finance and Technology teams
* Support tools and systems outsourcing arrangements where required
* Identify and deliver day\-to\-day process automation solutions across the CPS business
* Build a close partnership with broader CPS Pricing team and the wider business to deliver process enhancement, build technical capability, and drive continuous improvement for areas of responsibility

 **Key Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:**

  

* Demonstrable track record of development of DB pricing or Solvency II and related actuarial models, tools and processes
* Excellent software development skills (C\# strongly preferred; Python \& VBA experience valuable)
* Qualified Actuary or actuarial skillset required
* Strong knowledge of at least one area of DB benefits, IFRS 17 and Solvency UK for life insurance (in particular balance sheet construction). Asset strategy \& ALM valuable
* Ambitious and self\-motivated with ability to work on own initiative/prioritise workload to strict deadlines
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to bridge the gap between actuarial and IT

 **Location:** London or Edinburgh

**Work Level:** Manager / Expert

**Recruiter:** Amy Curtis

**What we offer:**

  

We’re dedicated to supporting your wellbeing and helping you thrive, both at work and beyond. Our benefits are designed to help you balance your professional and personal life**,** and financially plan for the future. **Our UK benefits include**:

  

* A valuable **pension scheme of up to 18%** (13% made up of employer contributions and 5% employee contributions).
* Access to our **Share Save** and **Share Incentive Plan,** alongside financial wellbeing and support services to help **give you real confidence to put your money to work.**
* Enjoy 38 days annual leave (including bank holidays), with the opportunity to purchase up to five extra days. Our **Time Off When You Need It** policy gives you the flexibility \- to balance work and personal commitments.
* Our market\-leading **Inspiring Families** policy includes comprehensive support and paid parental leave covering maternity, adoption, surrogacy, and paternity leave \- because supporting families is an important part of our inclusive culture.
* Health \& Protection cover includes **Private Healthcare, Critical Illness cover** and **Life Assurance** for you, with additional family options \- for peace of mind.

  

To explore more about life at M\&G and our full benefits offering, visit **Life at M\&G**

  

At M\&G we strive to have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, underpinned by our policies and employee\-led networks that offer networking, support and development opportunities for the diverse communities our colleagues represent. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds – across gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation and more – including neurodivergent individuals, career returners and those with military service experience.

  

M\&G is proud to be **Level 3:** **Disability Confident Leader**under the UK Government Disability Confident employer scheme, and we welcome applications from candidates with disabilities and long\-term health conditions. If you would like to participate in the initiative, you will have the opportunity to indicate this on your application.

  

We are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. All candidates have the opportunity to request reasonable adjustments when applying. If you need any additional support at any stage, please contact us at: careers@mandg.com

jobs.title: Landscape Architect
jobs.description:
**Help us create places people are proud to call home.**


We’re looking for a talented **Landscape Architect** to join Hill and help shape the landscape, public realm and placemaking across our residential and mixed\-use developments.


Working across projects from **early concept and planning through to detailed design and delivery**, you’ll collaborate with our Land, Planning, Technical, Development and Construction teams to create high\-quality, sustainable and distinctive places.

### **What you’ll be doing**

* Providing landscape design input across new and live developments
* Supporting site layouts, masterplans and placemaking strategies
* Reviewing and coordinating all landscape designs
* Creating and developing hard and soft landscape proposals
* Supporting planning applications and landscape conditions
* Integrating **Biodiversity Net Gain, SuDS and green infrastructure**
* Working with multidisciplinary teams to ensure designs are practical, coordinated and deliverable
* Visiting sites to help maintain landscape quality through construction

### **What we’re looking for**

* Degree or postgraduate qualification in **Landscape Architecture**
* Experience within a landscape practice, developer, housebuilder or multidisciplinary environment
* Good understanding of the **UK planning system**
* Knowledge of BNG, sustainable drainage and green infrastructure
* Strong design skills with a practical and commercially aware approach
* Experience taking projects from concept and planning through to delivery

**What you’ll get:**

* 26 days holiday
* Private healthcare and wellbeing platform
* Hill Incentive scheme and retail discounts
* Volunteering days and continuous learning opportunities
* A high\-performing and supportive team culture
* competitive salary and package

**Why Hill?**


At Hill, we offer more than just a job — we offer the opportunity to make a real and lasting impact. Every person here contributes to delivering sustainable, high\-quality homes and shaping vibrant communities across the UK.


Our culture is underpinned by our values:

* **Ambition** – we set bold goals and support each other to exceed them
* **Impact** – we focus on delivering meaningful outcomes
* **Agility** – we move quickly, adapt confidently, and embrace change
* **Collaboration** – we work together to achieve more, sharing success along the way


As a privately owned business, we’re able to move with pace and purpose. We invest in people, support career growth, and empower individuals to lead from wherever they stand. Hard\-working, driven people thrive here — and are recognised for what they deliver and how they deliver it.


Join Hill and be part of a forward\-thinking, values\-led team. Together, we’re not just building homes — we’re building a lasting legacy.


We are proud to be a **Disability Confident Employer**. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and can provide adjustments throughout the recruitment process.


This is a great opportunity to influence landscape design across Hill’s developments and help us create **distinctive, sustainable places with a lasting legacy**.

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer 2-10pm
jobs.description:
**Role specifics**

* Salary range: £32,000 per annum
* Reporting to: Support Team Lead
* Key stakeholders: Product team, Tech team, Professional Services team
* Organisational Framework Level: 2 – Technical Contributor

**About you/ Job Summary**


As an Application Support Engineer, you will be comfortable engaging with customers via telephone, email, or a case management system such as Salesforce – providing the right solutions to customers' issues. You will thrive in a fast\-paced environment and be an expert at time management, ensuring the timely execution of all tasks and deadlines. You will champion improvements that will increase customer satisfaction, manage escalations and collaborate with other team members to minimise service disruptions, reducing downtime.

  

This position will be working from 2\-10pm Monday to Friday as part of our ongoing commitment to support our customers on a 24/7 basis.

 **Key Accountabilities**

* Provide first\-line customer support via our case management system, email, and telephone and be the SME for first\-line resolution of complex cases
* Contribute to quarterly reviews with Enterprise customers to talk through software utilisation, upcoming releases, and ticket trends
* Liaise with customers to understand and investigate issues raised, responding promptly with an appropriate resolution or escalation
* Support the Customer Success Managers with any support\-related queries
* Become a subject matter expert on the Clue application
* Monitor the support inbox for new tickets, provide first contact resolution or triage accordingly
* Build excellent customer relationships
* Lead bi\-weekly calls with our Enterprise support customers to review their outstanding tickets
* Contribute to continuous improvement across support services
* Record up\-to\-date and accurate information on our case management system, communicate updates and work with the support teams to resolve customer tickets within agreed SLA’s

**Key role measures**

* Customer satisfaction via Net Promotor Score from customer surveys
* Customer ticket response and closure KPI’s
* Meeting customer service level agreements
* Levels of resolved / unresolved support related issues

**Experience and skills**

**Our ideal candidate would have experience in the following areas:**

* Ability to achieve security clearance
* Minimum 2 years in an application support role
* Experience of excelling in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience with Salesforce ticketing system or similar
* Experience with deployment tools such as Octopus or similar
* Experience of Azure (primary) AWS (secondary) cloud services and technologies
* Experience of .SQL server, however desirable if additionally .NET, visual studio, as well as with C\#, ASP. NET Core and Javascript.
* Experience using monitoring and analytical tools such as AppInsights and devtools. Experience with Dynatrace would be advantageous.
* Experience with SQL databases, writing queries and scripting
* Experience in software testing, and/or troubleshooting is desirable
* Good understanding of ITIL best practice is desirable
  

  

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**


If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us more about yourself. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


We believe that seeing the world from all sorts of angles makes life better for all. We want you to know that the things that make you an individual, like your identity, age, ethnicity, religion, ability and background, are things that we choose to celebrate and support.


We are a scale\-up company, and as we continue to grow, we are passionate that having a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace will remain at our core. We are creating an inclusive environment where our people can thrive.


Our values are aligned and at the heart of everything we do. We are respectful, united, rigorous, relentless and ethical.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Mid-Level)
jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Mid\-Level) – Bravissimo IT


37\.5 hrs per week, Full Time, Hybrid (minimum 1 day per week in Leamington office)
  

Salary: 35\-50K

**About Bravissimo**


Part of Wacoal Europe Group, Bravissimo is an award\-winning, multi\-channel lingerie retailer on a mission to uplift women. Since 1995, our purpose has stayed the same: to inspire our customers to feel supported, celebrated, and confident every day.


We have 26 shops in the UK alongside a thriving ecommerce community, which offers a wide range of beautiful lingerie, swimwear and nightwear for women who wear a D to L cup, giving them so much choice.


We are on an exciting journey of growth and are loving every minute of it!

**Bravissimo Benefits**

* Up to 25 days holiday
* The opportunity to buy up to 5 additional days holiday each year
* Access to free and confidential 24/7 employee support from Retail Trust
* 50% discount on full priced items for you, your family \& friends, up to a limit
* Healthcare Cash Plan for you and up to 4 children through Medicash
* Employer pension contributions up to 6%
* Life Assurance
* Great training and learning resources
* Long service awards after 5 years’ service
* Access to new and upcoming products, with the opportunity to provide feedback
* Access to discounts at many retailers, day out destinations and gyms through Retail Trust and Medicash
* Free parking at Bra HQ

**About the role**


We're looking for a mid\-level Software Engineer to join our Back of House engineering team and help build, support and evolve a range of business\-critical applications. Working across a range of Bravissimo applications, you'll develop APIs, backend services and event\-driven solutions that support key business areas including product management, customer acquisition, ordering and fulfilment.


Bravissimo is in the middle of a major digital transformation programme, with plans to transition our legacy .NET estate to new service\-based architectures. We're evolving towards a full\-stack engineering environment, with TypeScript, Node.js, React and AWS at the heart of our modern applications and services.


You'll contribute to modern cloud\-based solutions while also supporting established business\-critical applications as part of our ongoing technology modernisation programme.


This is a hands\-on development role for someone who enjoys writing quality software, problem solving and continually developing their technical skills. It requires a blend of backend and frontend skills, but with a heavy focus on the backend. You'll work collaboratively to shape technical solutions and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support, maintain and improve existing business applications, preparing them for the digital transformation.
* Build and support scalable applications using TypeScript, JavaScript and Node.js.
* Design, develop and maintain APIs, backend services and integrations, and cloud\-based solutions.
* Work with databases and data integrations across multiple systems.
* Contribute to event\-driven and API\-led architectures.
* Troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable solutions.
* Participate in the ongoing modernisation of legacy systems and platforms.
* Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

Technical environment


Target technology stack and tooling:

* AWS microservice capabilities
* REST APIs
* Event\-Driven Architecture
* Grafana
* GitLab
* Jira

Experience with every technology isn't expected, but a willingness to learn and develop new skills is essential.  

  



**About you**


You're a competent, self\-motivated engineer, able to demonstrate your skills and provide examples of applications you've contributed to. Experience in a retail environment would be beneficial but is not essential.  

  



You'll also:

* Take pride in delivering well\-thought\-out solutions.
* Build good working relationships across teams and contribute constructively to technical discussions.
* Ask questions, challenge assumptions where appropriate, and stay curious about better ways of doing things.
**Essential Skills**

* Strong coding skills using TypeScript, JavaScript or a comparable modern language.
* .NET development
* Building and supporting production applications, APIs and services.
* Comfortable supporting and evolving existing business\-critical applications while contributing to the development of modern cloud\-native solutions.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Understanding of system integration patterns, APIs and event\-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and practical experience using AWS or Azure.
* Using Git\-based version control in a collaborative development environment.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving issues within live production systems.
* Experience working in an Agile delivery team.
* Strong testing mindset, including unit testing, regression testing and providing clear evidence that solutions are working before work is considered complete.
**Desirable Skills**

* AWS services, particularly serverless technologies such as Lambda.
* Designing and building cloud\-native applications.
* Containerisation and Kubernetes.
* Observability, monitoring and logging platforms such as Grafana.
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* GitLab experience.
* Experience supporting or modernising legacy business applications.
* Experience with distributed or event\-driven systems.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools to support productivity, learning, code quality and problem\-solving, while applying sound engineering judgement and taking accountability for the solutions delivered.

**Interested?**


If this role sounds like a perfect fit for you, we’d absolutely love to hear from you! Just click the ‘Apply Now’ button below and you’ll be taken to a new page where you can send us your application.


Please include your CV and a cover letter telling us why you’d love to join Bravissimo and what you’d bring to the role. We really do read every single one \- honestly! and we can’t move forward without it, so take this as your moment to tell us your story (as we love getting to know you) and your why!


If this opportunity makes you feel excited (we hope it does!), don’t wait too long to apply as we may close the advert early if we receive lots of applications.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
* **High\-quality culture** \- we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
* **Impact from day one** \- we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
* **AI\-first** \- we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

 **Our hiring process**

* **Introductory call (30 mins):** a casual chat with one or two of our product team
* **Technical interview (90 mins):** a collaborative, open\-book session with two engineers, working through a real\-world problem together
* **Call with founders (30 mins):** we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
* **Final response:** we'll follow up promptly with next steps

 **Kota benefits**

* Health insurance via Kota
* Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
* WFH stipend to support your home office setup
* Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
* Access to office space in Dublin or a co\-working space, wherever you're based
* Flexible working hours, we're remote\-first with some fixed hours for team alignment


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 **Who We Are**


Airwallex is a technology company that revolutionises the way businesses operate globally. Our financial infrastructure provides a modern technology stack for businesses to operate internationally, without the challenges of the current global financial system.


Businesses use Airwallex as their end\-to\-end global financial services platform. Whether it’s making or receiving payments from customers, domestically or internationally, Airwallex saves businesses time and money by offering real\-time, reliable and cost\-effective financial solutions. Our web and API solutions support businesses of all sizes, from small companies to large enterprises.


In this fast\-changing digital world that is increasingly becoming borderless, our mission is to empower businesses of all sizes to grow in their own markets and around the world, and by doing so, contribute to the global economy.

**You Will**

* Work directly with developers, merchants and internal teams on post integration issues to provide technical support, consulting and best practices. External customers contact through tickets. Internal customers use different contact avenues depending on priority.
* Conduct test scenarios for technical issues with code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints.
* Install and configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products.
* Communicate technical issues to customers and internal departments.
* Identify irregularities in functionality and unexpected behaviors with Airwallex products and services.
* Develop in\-depth technical information (sample code, log searching, FAQs) for distribution to customers.
* Support the communication, response and coordination between clients and internal key stakeholders and senior leadership as part of our Global Incident Management process.
* Complete occasional weekend work and holiday coverage as the business requires for on\-call duties.

**Skills And Experience You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or relevant majors
* Proven years of working experience in either programming, technical support, implementation or relevant jobs.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to communicate clearly and appropriately with internal and customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Prioritisation, organisation and detail oriented on ticket handling, able to work on multiple urgent issues in parallel.
* Must have sufficient technical knowledge to communicate with Engineering and Product teams
* Strong willingness to provide exceptional customer service
* Demonstrated quick learning of technology and new products
* Experienced in the e\-commerce, payment, fintech industry is a plus

**Technical Skills:**

* Experience in one of the programming languages: Python, Java, php, C\#, Java Script or shell scripting
* Familiarity with Web Technologies, HTTP and HTTPS
* Experience with REST, JSON, SOAP
* Experience with SQL
* Familiarity with Splunk, Grafana
* Experience in e\-commerce, payment, fin\-tech industry is a plus

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**What is Digital Speed?**

Digital Speed is a full\-service product and engineering agency delivering strategy, design, and development for global clients. Our expertise spans Brand, Discovery, UX/UI, and Full\-Stack Engineering, alongside product strategy and marketing. We partner with organisations in finance, automotive, sport, and technology to ship dependable, high\-quality outcomes at scale.We are driven by 4 key values:

* Open – We arrive with options, welcome feedback, and find the best way forward together.
* Thriving – New challenges energise us; we learn and improve as a team.
* Experts – Specialists who care about their craft and deliver results with structure.
* Caring – We take our clients’ goals as seriously as our own and build trusted relationships.

**Where do you fit in?**

You'll join as a full\-stack engineer in London, working closely with agency leadership and a client teams to build various products. Your main account will include a product aimed at engineers and AI coding agents. You'll shape high\-quality engineering practices, reusable components, strong pipelines, production\-ready software while owning the parts of the product that determine whether developers and agents actually succeed with it: documentation, onboarding, and sandbox testing. This is a role for someone who enjoys breadth and ownership: context\-switching across languages, designing for both human and machine consumers, and collaborating across agency and client teams.

**Responsibilities**

* **Core Engineering:** Design and build robust, reusable services and libraries across multiple languages (Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, Go), for a product consumed by both developers and AI coding agents.
* **Documentation:** Build and maintain a docs\-as\-code platform \- API references, quickstarts, and guides \- structured for both human readability and machine parsing (OpenAPI/JSON Schema, MCP tool definitions, llms.txt where relevant).
* **Onboarding:** Design and build the onboarding path from signup to first successful integration \- CLI/SDK scaffolding, guided setup, and error handling clear enough for an agent to self\-correct on, not just a human.
* **Sandbox Testing:** Build isolated sandbox environments \- mock services, seeded test data, ephemeral instances \- where engineers and agents can safely test integrations without touching production.
* **Architecture \& Review:** Analyse requirements, propose technical approaches, and lead peer reviews to maintain high standards.
* **CI/CD \& Quality Gates:** Implement and refine pipelines with linting, tests/coverage, artifact signing, and versioning discipline.
* **Release Management:** Ensure clean, traceable, secure releases across environments, with strong changelog hygiene — especially important where agents consume versioned APIs programmatically.
* **Collaboration \& Handover:** Work directly with the client's Architecture/Platform teams; produce documentation, run\-books, and recorded walkthroughs as part of agency delivery.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Optimise build times, automate repeatable tasks, and keep outputs deterministic and reproducible.

**Characteristics**

* **Simplify:** Turn messy requirements into clear, repeatable systems \- and clear systems into documentation that needs no follow\-up questions.
* **High\-performance:** Care about reliability, observability, and regression safety.
* **Collaborative:** Give/receive reviews; document decisions; unblock others.
* **First\-principles:** Handle ambiguity and make trade\-offs explicit.
* **Ownership:** Proactive, organised, and comfortable leading end\-to\-end \- from architecture through to the docs page a developer or an agent is reading when they get stuck.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years building production software (libraries, services, or dev\-tools a plus \- developer platforms or API products especially relevant here).
* Proficiency in Java \& TypeScript. Skills in C\#/.NET, Python \& Go are a bonus.
* Solid grasp of modern API and integration patterns.
* Experience building or maintaining developer\-facing documentation: docs\-as\-code, API reference generation, or interactive examples.
* Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins), git, and code review.
* Experience publishing artifacts and managing repos (Maven, NuGet, PyPI, Nexus/Artifactory).
* Working knowledge of semantic versioning, release notes, and changelog hygiene.
* Basic security hygiene: artifact signing, checksums, SBOM mindset.
* Right to work in the UK; fluent in written and spoken English.

**Desirable Extras**

* Experience designing APIs or tools built for AI agent consumption \- function calling, MCP, tool/schema design.
* Building sandbox environments, mock servers, or contract/conformance testing frameworks.
* Go (concurrency patterns), idiomatic TypeScript design.
* Docs\-as\-code, ADRs, conformance/contract testing.
* Exposure to OAuth/OIDC, mTLS, and PKI basics.
* Cloud \& infra awareness (AWS/Azure/GCP, containers, runners).
* Prior agency/consulting experience and/or regulated industries.

Mott MacDonald Bentley is a fully integrated design and build business combining the design expertise of Mott MacDonald with the contracting experience of JN Bentley to deliver award winning projects. Working for Mott MacDonald Bentley, you will work on major water and wastewater schemes throughout all phases of the project from feasibility through to construction. With an annual turnover surpassing £600 million, Mott Macdonald Bentley cements its position as a leader within the industry. The sustained, robust business performance creates an ideal environment for career growth.

  

As part of our appointment to Scottish Water’s new Enterprise, we will deliver projects at sites across Scotland. Works will include major upgrades to treatment assets, new and enhanced networks, and resilience schemes that will benefit communities across the country.

  

**25\+ years in the water sector**

  

Over successive regulatory periods, MMB has delivered a wide range of complex water and wastewater projects that directly support SR27 priorities, including:

  

* Enhancing resilience and service reliability through treatment works upgrades, network improvements and resilience schemes


* Supporting net zero and climate adaptation via low carbon design, nature based solutions and environmental compliance projects


* Enabling sustainable growth by delivering infrastructure that supports new development and protects existing communities


* Driving efficiency and affordability through integrated delivery, innovation and collaborative planning


* Maintaining a strong focus on customers, communities and safety across everything we do

  

As a Principal Civil Engineer you'll work on projects that make a real difference to our environment and our communities \- enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of water and wastewater treatment systems.


You will play a pivotal role in shaping the civil functions throughout the lifecycle of various projects. From concept design to commissioning, you will ensure that all civil aspects are meticulously considered and integrated.

  

**The role of a Principal Civil Engineer includes:**

  

* Lead and oversee the design, planning, and execution of civil engineering on projects.


* Providing design support and guidance for schemes and ensuring all designs are fit for purpose and meet current legislation and standards


* Working closely and collaboratively with the commercial, operational and construction teams to develop efficient, practical and safe solutions throughout design stages, construction and beyond


* Positively engage with the client, managing relationships and adopting a one\-team approach to supporting them in achieving their aims


* Managing the interfaces and integration of the civil design with that of other disciplines and production of documentation


* Acting as technical checker on project documents, and undertaking technical reviews for projects across teams


* Identifying opportunities to improve delivery processes including development and implementation of standard designs, sustainable solutions, and digital tools


* Undertaking site reviews to ensure buildability of solutions and integration within the existing systems


* Supporting the development of the civil engineering team, coaching and mentoring engineers to develop their skill set and identifying the correct resource for the projects

  

**What you’ll need:**

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or related field


* Chartership (CEng) with a relevant Engineering Institution


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in civil engineering including hydraulic and concrete structure design.


* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.


* Experience of successfully delivering high quality outputs in accordance with design, quality and safety standards


* Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders


* A willingness to travel to sites across your operational region

  

**Preferred skills:**

  

* Experience with sustainable design and green building practices.


* Proficiency in civil engineering software and tools.


* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards applicable within the water and wastewater sector


* Experience of temporary works design

  

**What’s in it for you:**

  

Alongside our significant training and development investment and bespoke progression plan, we offer a wide range of financial, lifestyle, health and wellbeing benefits that you can tailor to your needs. At Mott MacDonald Bentley you will be offered a competitive salary which is commensurate based on your experience. Our core benefits include:

  

* Pension matched by employer up to 7%


* Option to purchase, sell and carry over annual leave


* Life assurance / Private Medical Insurance / Critical Illness Insurance and Health Screening options


* 26 weeks maternity leave, enhanced paternity and adoption leave/ Shared parental leave


* Payment of annual professional institution subscription costs


* Gym Membership discounts UK wide


* Cycle to work scheme, interest free season ticket loans and discounted dining cards also available

  

\*\*Mott MacDonald Bentley are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.\*\*

  

**Other Information**


**About Mott MacDonald**


Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management and development consultancy.


Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

  

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.


**Our values:** progress, respect, integrity, drive, excellence.

  

**We believe that because we care about what we do, we do things better.**


We know that our people are our most valuable asset, so we are dedicated to investing in them, through our comprehensive training and development schemes, exposure to the wider design and build business and endless opportunities.

  

We are committed to creating a workplace where our people are safe, have a voice, can reach their full potential, and everyone shares in the rewards.


You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that benefit our communities – from helping to secure water supplies for future generations to protecting homes and businesses from flood risk – our projects make a real difference.

  

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**


A Mott MacDonald Bentley we welcome applications from all sectors of the community. We are dedicated to building a diverse workplace where everyone feels included, has the opportunity to thrive, and is treated with respect.

  

Even if you don’t meet every requirement for this role but are excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Find out more about our approach to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion here: https://www.mottmacbentley.co.uk/people.

  

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment practices are barrier\-free and as inclusive as possible. This includes making adjustments during the job application process and throughout your future career with us. Please call 01756 691572 or email recruitment@jnbentley.co.uk to discuss any such adjustments that we can make. You can read more about our Equal Opportunities Policy here: Equality, diversity and inclusion \- Mott MacDonald

  

**Agile working**


We are committed to providing a flexible and agile working environment that supports both our employees and the needs of the business.

  

\#LI\-MMB

jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800\+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.



Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource\-library/customer\-stories

**About the role:**



As a Solutions Platform Engineer, you'll build and run the technical infrastructure that supports Appfire's Solutions Group. You'll own our demo environments end to end, build self\-service sandboxes for Solution Partners, and automate technical processes that enable Sales Engineers and Solutions Architects to spend more time with customers. You'll also help transition successful field\-built prototypes into production by partnering with Engineering and DevOps on code ownership, hosting, and support models. This is a highly cross\-functional role focused on reducing technical overhead, improving time\-to\-demo, and creating scalable solutions infrastructure.


**What you'll do:**


* Own the demo estate end to end, including Atlassian instance provisioning, realistic seeded datasets, multi\-product reference environments, and environment teardown and refresh.
* Build and maintain self\-service sandbox environments that enable Solution Partners to demonstrate Appfire products independently.
* Design and implement automation that reduces technical overhead for Sales Engineering and Solutions Architecture teams and improves time\-to\-demo.
* Maintain the technical knowledge base supporting security questionnaires, RFPs, and trust center responses.
* Run the Instance Optimization inventory extract and pricing pull supporting Appfire's consolidation assessment.
* Take ownership of field\-built prototypes that graduate to production, including code ownership, hosting, deployment, and ongoing support in partnership with Engineering and DevOps.
* Define and enforce technical graduation criteria for prototypes moving from pilot to production, ensuring each solution has clear ownership, hosting, and support models.
* Monitor demo environment health, provisioning performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving technical bottlenecks.


**What you'll need:**


* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or systems engineering, ideally supporting a sales engineering, solutions, or presales organization.
* Hands\-on experience administering and provisioning Atlassian Cloud and/or Data Center environments, including Jira, Confluence, and/or Bitbucket.
* Experience building and operating self\-service sandbox or demo environments, including environment lifecycle management and seeded or synthetic data.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation, scripting such as Python or Bash, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Practical experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling.
* Experience taking ownership of existing tools or prototypes and preparing them for production, including code review, hosting, deployment, and support.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge bases for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Solutions, Sales Engineering, Product Engineering, and DevOps teams in a fast\-moving environment.


**What we offer:**


* Help build the technical platform and operating model that enables Appfire's Solutions organization to scale.
* Opportunity to define and automate how demo environments, partner sandboxes, and field\-built solutions are built and operated.
* Work across Appfire's product portfolio and the Atlassian ecosystem with direct impact on how our solutions teams support customers and partners


**Company Equity:** Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a strong sense of ownership and connection to our growth.


**Time Off \& Wellbeing**


* 26 Vacation Days: Paid vacation annually, regardless of tenure  

Wellness Days: 1 fully paid day off each month for rest, recovery, or unexpected personal needs  

Volunteering: 24 hours of paid volunteer time plus 3 fully paid volunteering days


**Learning \& Development**


* Appfire University: Custom, on\-demand learning platform supporting continuous learning, professional development, and career growth
* Health \& Insurance
* Private Healthcare: Fully covered Luxmed plan, with the option to extend coverage to your partner or add personalized upgrades  

Life Insurance: Fully paid UNUM life insurance


**Lifestyle \& Everyday Benefits**


* MyBenefit: 150 PLN per month for a Multisport card, shopping, restaurants, and entertainment
* Lunch Card: 300 PLN per month for groceries or dining out via a virtual Pluxee card, with Google Pay and Apple Wallet support
* Remote Work Support


**Home Office Allowance:** 200 PLN net per month to help cover electricity and internet costs while working remotely

 **Market recognition**



Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000\. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.


**Equal Employer Opportunity (EEO)**

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Senior Security Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a CDU Analyst to support the (AMR or KRK) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll support the day\-to\-day operations of the team and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Respond in a Tier 2 role including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Support and develop CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required
	+ 5\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 2\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have
  

	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance
* Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. \#hybrid
*Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.*
*Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:**Family \& Medical Leave Act**,* *Equal Opportunity Employment**,* *Employee Polygraph Protection Act*
*Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.*
*Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one\-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics \- upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam \- we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info \- so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.*

jobs.description:
### **Twoja rola:**


* Współpraca z klientami: Przeprowadzanie analizy potrzeb klientów oraz identyfikacja możliwości zastosowania sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego w danym obszarze biznesowym.
* Projektowanie rozwiązań: Opracowywanie i proponowanie innowacyjnych rozwiązań w oparciu o technologie Microsoft, które spełniają konkretne wymagania i cele biznesowe klientów.
* Projekty: Uczestnictwo w projektach wdrożeniowych z zakresu wdrożenia nowoczesnych aplikacji napędzanych przez sztuczną inteligencje (Chatbot, inteligentne wyszukiwarki, automatyzacja przetwarzania dokumentów z wykorzystaniem NLP itp.) a także w projektach związanych z zaawansowaną analityką wykorzysującą metody Machine Learning (prognoza, segmentacja, detekcja anomalii itp.)
* Badania i rozwój: Śledzenie najnowszych trendów, technologii i narzędzi w dziedzinie sztucznej inteligencji i uczenia maszynowego, oraz wnioskowanie o ich potencjalnym zastosowaniu w projektach. Przygotowanie aplikacji demo w ramach wewnętrznego R\&D.

### **Czego oczekujemy?**


* Doświadczenie w projektach związanych z implementacją rozwiązań uczenia maszynowego, obejmujące budowę, trenowanie, optymalizację, wdrażanie, monitorowanie oraz utrzymanie modeli ML w środowisku produkcyjnym.
* Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu, trenowaniu i wdrażaniu modeli ML, w tym ich integracji z systemami produkcyjnymi oraz utrzymaniem w chmurze w usługach Azure Machine Learning oraz Fabric. Znajomość Databrics oraz Synapse będzie dodatkowym atutem.
* Znajomość zasad MLOps, obejmująca w szczególności automatyzację pipeline’ów ML, wersjonowanie modeli i danych, monitorowanie ich jakości oraz zarządzanie pełnym cyklem życia modeli.
* Doświadczenie w walidacji modeli ML oraz ich wersjonowaniu w środowisku produkcyjnym, z uwzględnieniem monitoringu, testów regresyjnych i kontroli dryfu.
* Znajomość narzędzi do zarządzania eksperymentami ML, takich jak MLflow, Azure ML, oraz praktyczne doświadczenie w walidacji, porównywaniu i fine‑tuningu modeli.
* Znajomość języków programowania – wymagane: Python; mile widziane: SQL, C\#.
* Umiejętność efektywnej komunikacji i pracy z klientami, w tym tłumaczenia złożonych zagadnień technicznych na język zrozumiały dla odbiorców nietechnicznych.
* Znajomość koncepcji i doświadczenie z technikami generatywnej AI, takimi jak prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, bazy wektorowe oraz podstawy fine‑tuningu LLM‑ów.
* Doświadczenie w pracy z dużymi modelami językowymi (LLM)
* Znajomość MAF (Microsoft AI Framework) , LangChain, LangGraph jako narzędzi wspierającegych budowę aplikacji wykorzystujących modele językowe i usługi Azure AI.
* Znajomość narzędzi i platform Microsoft związanych z AI, takich jak Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services.

### **Co oferujemy?**


* Swobodę w działaniu oraz decyzyjność
* Kulturę organizacyjną opartą na odpowiedzialności, zaufaniu i realizacji założonych celów
* Elastyczne godziny pracy, możliwość częściowej pracy zdalnej
* Szkolenia i certyfikacje Microsoft
* Opiekę medyczną, Kartę Multisport, Ubezpieczenie na Życie, naukę języka angielskiego

jobs.title: 2027 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Poland
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?
  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.
  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.
  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high\-impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.
  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon work\-day. Applicants should have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after their internship concludes.
  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
  

  

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into well\-defined, solvable components before implementation.
  

  

Contribute to the design and development of scalable, reliable services, with distributed\-systems scope varying by team.
  

  

Participate in code reviews as a core engineering practice, providing constructive feedback and validating correctness.
  

  

Contribute to clear and accurate technical documentation.
  

  

Use GenAI and AI\-powered tools to enhance development productivity, and critically validate, verify, and integrate AI\-generated code, exercising sound judgement about when to trust AI output.
  

  

Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
  

  

Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on\-call duties.
  

  

Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.
  

  

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.
  

  

About the team  

Intern Community:
  

  

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
  

  

Support:
  

  

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
  

  

Learning Sessions:
  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
  

  

Opportunities:
  

  

Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Are enrolled in a Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields at time of application
* Knowledge of computer science fundamentals such as object\-oriented design, operating systems, algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis
* Experience with at least one general\-purpose programming language such as Java, Python, C\+\+, C\#, Go, Rust, or TypeScript

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience from a technical internship
* Experience with distributed, multi\-tiered systems, algorithms, and relational databases
* Experience in optimization mathematics such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open\-source projects, and/or version control systems
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
* Ability to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions
* Adept at handling ambiguous or undefined problems as well as ability to think abstractly
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Du har också erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med React, Angular eller Next.js samt av cloud, Azure, CI/CD och DevOps.

* Har erfarenhet av API:er, backendtjänster och integrationer

Med expertis inom systemutveckling, AI, cybersäkerhet, molntjänster, digitala kundupplevelser och managementkonsulting utvecklar vi lösningar som bidrar till ett mer hållbart och mänskligt samhälle.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
**Cloud Engineer**

**Team: Engineering \- Location: Stockholm**

  

Pacera unifies financial close, consolidation and FP\&A into one intelligent platform. With AARO, Aico and Mercur, finance teams turn trusted data into AI\-driven insight — powering robust, scalable, and smarter decision\-making for the Office of the CFO.

 **About the role**


We're looking for a Mid/Senior Cloud Engineer to join our Infrastructure team of 6 and help operate and maintain the production environment behind our SaaS platform. You'll work across a hybrid environment of Windows and Linux virtual machines, supporting applications built on .NET and Java, running on top of VMware and OpenStack, with some services also running in Azure.
  

  

Our environment relies heavily on client VPNs and IPSEC point\-to\-point tunnels for remote and site connectivity, so extensive networking and firewall skills are essential.  

  

We manage our infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, so solid coding/scripting skills are necessary for this role. This is a hands\-on operational role focused on keeping our platform reliable, secure, and performing well in production.

 **What You'll Do**

* Maintain and monitor production infrastructure for our SaaS platform, ensuring high availability and performance
* Manage and troubleshoot both Windows and Linux virtual machines in production environments
* Administer and optimize virtualization infrastructure on VMware and OpenStack
* Manage and troubleshoot client VPN access and IPSEC point\-to\-point tunnels, working with firewalls and network infrastructure
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and performance of .NET and Java applications running in production
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code to provision, configure, and manage our environment
* Respond to and resolve incidents, performing root cause analysis to prevent recurrence
* Perform routine maintenance tasks: patching, updates, backups, and capacity planning
* Log, track, and update work using our ticketing system; collaborate with development teams to support releases and deployments into production
* Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and automation to reduce manual operational work
* Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and runbook

**What We're Looking For**


Must\-haves:

* Several years' hands\-on experience administering both Windows Server and Linux environments in production
* Experience with OpenStack or comparable private cloud/IaaS platforms
* Familiarity supporting production applications built on Java
* Solid networking and firewall knowledge, including experience with client VPNs and IPSEC site\-to\-site tunnels
* Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, OS, and application layers
* Comfortable owning incidents in a production environment with high uptime requirements
* Solid coding/scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) and experience with Infrastructure as Code
* Experience with Datadog or similar observability platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bicep
* Experience working with Jira or a similar ticketing/issue\-tracking system


Nice\-to\-haves:

* Experience with NixOS
* Experience with container\-based environments (e.g Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience with Microsoft Azure (or another public cloud) in a production setting
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation
* Familiarity with firewall platforms (Clavister, Fortinet)
* Relevant certifications (VMware VCP, Linux, Microsoft/Azure, OpenStack, or networking certs like CCNA)
* Prior experience in a SaaS or always\-on production environment

**What we offer**

* The opportunity to be part of our next phase of growth and expansion, backed by strategic private equity investment
* Competitive compensation and benefits package including pension, flex hours, wellness allowances and more
* Hybrid working options

**About Pacera**  

Pacera is redefining financial operations for the Office of the CFO — powering planning, financial close, consolidation, and reporting through one unified platform, trusted by 700\+ organisations and 70,000\+ users across more than 140 countries.


Our platform brings together three specialised products — **Aico by Pacera**, **AARO by Pacera**, and **Mercur by Pacera** — giving finance teams the accuracy, control, and confidence they need to run mission\-critical operations, without compromise.

* **Aico** automates and streamlines financial close processes
* **Mercur** powers FP\&A, budgeting, forecasting, business intelligence, and financial analytics
* **AARO** delivers consolidation and group reporting solutions
  

Each product has a loyal customer base and a strong track record of growth. Built on decades of proven expertise, our platform helps finance and executive leaders automate, govern, and make faster, smarter decisions.

  

We're headquartered in Stockholm, with offices across Sweden, Finland, Latvia, and the UK. And we're driven by the same principles wherever we are: collaboration, continuous learning, flexibility, curiosity, and the drive to win together.

  

Backed by Accel\-KKR, a global technology\-focused investment firm, the group has ambitious growth plans driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. We are now strengthening our operations by investing in key roles that support our platform and future scalability.

 **Apply now**


This is a permanent, full\-time position. The role will be based in Stockholm.

  

Our process typically involves an initial conversation with our recruitment team, a hiring manager interview, and a final stage interview including a role specific task.

  

We warmly welcome your application.

  

\-

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description:
**Product Engineer – AI\-drivet produktteam**

**Om rollen**


Vi söker en Product Engineer till ett produktteam som arbetar enligt ett AI\-assisterat arbetssätt, där stora delar av koden genereras med hjälp av AI\-verktyg.


I takt med att själva implementationsarbetet gått snabbare har fokus flyttats mot att formulera rätt krav, förstå domänen på djupet, bygga tydlig kontext och ge AI:n rätt förutsättningar för att leverera väl fungerande lösningar. I den här rollen blir du en nyckelperson i det arbetet.


Du förenar teknisk kompetens med produkt\- och kravarbete och driver frågor hela vägen från idé till färdig lösning – genom att ställa rätt frågor, strukturera och förbereda underlag, bygga relevant kontext för AI\-verktygen och säkerställa att kraven är tillräckligt tydliga för att omsättas i fungerande kod.


Du behåller samtidigt din tekniska hands\-on\-förmåga och bidrar vid behov med implementation, kodgranskning och testning av AI\-genererad kod. Fördelningen mellan kravarbete och utveckling varierar från uppgift till uppgift.


Rollen passar dig som trivs i skärningspunkten mellan produkt och teknik och som drivs av att vara med och forma nya arbetssätt där AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen. Du samarbetar tätt med produkt, arkitektur och utveckling, och får ett brett ansvar för att driva arbetet framåt – från identifierat behov till levererad funktionalitet.


Arbetet bedrivs i mindre, fokuserade team där du som Product Engineer har en central funktion i att samordna krav, skapa goda förutsättningar för utvecklingsarbetet och säkerställa att lösningen hänger ihop både funktionellt och tekniskt.

**Teknisk miljö**

* Backend: .NET Core
* Frontend: React
* Drift: Microsoft Azure
* Databas: MongoDB (Atlas)
* Miljön är ISO 27001\-certifierad och utvecklas enligt organisationens interna säkerhetsramverk och riktlinjer

**Kvalifikationer**

* Mycket god erfarenhet av Claude eller motsvarande AI\-baserade kodningsverktyg, och en stark förmåga att omsätta domänproblem och krav till tydliga, väl underbyggda prompter som leder till rätt tekniskt resultat
* Gedigen teknisk kompetens och förmåga att själv koda för att granska, felsöka och vid behov skriva eller justera kod
* Förmåga att arbeta nära produktsidan, ställa rätt frågor, strukturera underlag och driva krav framåt utan att invänta färdiga specifikationer

**Meriterande**

* Erfarenhet av GDPR/dataskydd och/eller informationssäkerhet är meriterande, eftersom produkten verkar inom detta område och sådan kunskap stärker förmågan att formulera relevanta och välgrundade krav
