jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Data Ingestion Platform)
jobs.description:
**Who we are**


4C Strategies builds organisational readiness and military training management software for clients in over 70 countries. Our flagship product, Exonaut, is used by NATO and allied forces to plan, run and evaluate exercises in real time. Our consultants and engineers work alongside armed forces across the UK, Europe, North America and beyond to deliver training and exercise management solutions.

**What we're building**


We're building the data ingestion platform behind large\-scale training exercises: a service that takes traffic from simulation federations, unmanned\-system sensor networks and real\-world sensor feeds, and turns it into one coherent stream that subscribing systems can act on. The bet is that these streams should be interpreted and mapped to an internal Ontology rather than re\-interpreted by every product that needs it. So the hard part is as much modelling as engineering — deciding what those bytes actually mean, and then holding that meaning stable as the number of sources and consumers grows. The platform is greenfield, and you'll have real influence over its shape.

**How we build**


Modern Java. The principles are conservative on purpose: boring technology, simplicity over cleverness, in\-process over distributed, shared\-nothing over shared state, domain wrapped by ports and adapters. Redundancy is an architectural property, not an operational afterthought. Designs are argued from the problem, not from what a framework happens to make easy. Proposals go through RFCs; decisions are recorded in ADRs.


Two constraints shape most of what we do. Everything the platform produces must be traceable back to the raw feed and the exact configuration that produced it — a customer has to be able to replay an exercise and defend the result. And it has to run where exercises actually run: constrained hardware, intermittent connectivity, air\-gapped sites, limited patch windows, secure by design and observability good enough for an operator in the field with no one to call.

**You**


Substantial engineering experience, opinionated about design, and comfortable arguing a position in writing. Sound judgement on reliability, security, performance, operations and cost is mandatory. Familiarity with simulation or sensor standards, IoT, geospatial mathematics or high\-throughput ingestion is a real advantage — the domain is learnable, the principles less so. We'd also rather hear about how you simplified a distributed system rather than the one you built using multiple services.


The engineering team is small, but what we are building sits at the centre of the portfolio and draws the people who know this domain best — some of the strongest simulation and modelling expertise anywhere in the field is in this building, and closely engaged in what we're building. The bar is high. Your designs will be challenged, and you'll be expected to challenge back — including on scope, since most of the pressure on a platform like this comes as reasonable\-sounding requests for one more special case.


Research shows some people only apply when they meet every requirement. If you don't tick every box but recognise yourself in much of the above, please apply anyway. We'd genuinely like to hear from you.

**Security and citizenship**


This role supports defence work, so the successful candidate must hold Swedish citizenship and pass Swedish security vetting (säkerhetsprövning). We will explain what the check involves early in the process rather than late — a requirement like this should never be a surprise at offer stage.


This requirement comes only from the security rules that govern defence work, not from personal preference.

**Why it matters**


Deterrence works only when a capability is real, and a capability is only real once it has been trained and tested under conditions close to the ones it would face. This is about making sure the organisations that would hold the line are ready.

**How we hire**


Every interview has a written script and a scored rubric, applied the same way to every candidate.

* **Hiring Manager Screen** — a conversation about your experience, how you work and what


you want next.

* **System Design** — a design discussion drawn from problems like the ones above.
* **Programming** — a hands\-on session in a language of your choice (Java, C\#, TypeScript, Python or Go).
* **Culture Interview** — how you collaborate, disagree and make decisions with others.
* **Candidate Q\&A** — your time to interrogate us. We expect you to use it.


We then debrief as a panel and decide. We review applications on a rolling basis.

**What you can expect from 4C Strategies**

* Stockholm\-based, with hybrid working.
* Competitive salary, reviewed annually.
* Occupational pension (tjänstepension).
* Wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag).
* Healthcare insurance, including insurance for treatment.
* Parental pay.
* Vaccinations.
* A supportive, collaborative team building meaningful products for mission\-critical work.

**Why Join 4C Strategies**


If you're happiest when the path isn't drawn yet, this is a rare chance to own hard, open problems on a large, multi\-year programme — real scale, real production systems, and the freedom to shape how they're built — with a collaborative team to figure the hard parts out alongside you. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and military specialists, with the individual\-contributor track valued as highly as management, so you can grow without leaving the code behind.


The work matters: what you build helps armed forces, public safety and resilience organisations train, prepare, and respond. If you want senior\-level ownership on systems that are used in earnest — not a backlog ticket factory — this is that role.

**How to apply**


To apply, click the Apply today button and submit your CV. A short cover note on your experience and motivation is welcome but not required. We review applications on a rolling basis, so please apply as soon as you can.


4C Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Software Engineer
Overview  

  

We are the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.  

  

Our team within Mastercard – Services within Mastercard:  

  

The Data \& Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting\-edge services that are used by some of the world's largest organizations to make multi\-million dollar decisions and grow their businesses. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end\-to\-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centered on data\-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments\-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business Test \& Learn experimentation, and data\-driven information and risk management services.  

  

Advance Analytics Program:  

  

Within the D\&S Technology Team, the Advance Analytics program is a program that is comprised of a rich set of products that provide accurate perspectives on Credit Risk, Portfolio Optimization, and Ad Insights. Currently, we are enhancing our customer experience with new user interfaces, moving to API\-based data publishing to allow for seamless integration in other Mastercard products and externally, utilizing new data sets and algorithms to further analytic capabilities, and generating scalable big data processes.  

We are looking for an innovative software engineering manager who will lead the team responsible for the design and build of a full stack web application and data pipelines, and thrive in a fast\-paced, agile environment. This individual will partner closely with other areas of the business to build and enhance solutions that drive value for our customers.  

Engineers work in small, flexible teams. Every team member contributes to designing, building, and testing features. The range of work you will encounter varies from building intuitive, responsive UIs to designing backend data models, architecting data flows, and beyond. There are no rigid organizational structures, and each team uses processes that work best for its members and projects.  

  

Here are a few examples of products in our space:  

  

* Portfolio Optimizer (PO) is a solution that leverages Mastercard’s data assets and analytics to allow issuers to identify and increase revenue opportunities within their credit and debit portfolios.

  

* Audiences uses anonymized and aggregated transaction insights to offer targeting segments that have high likelihood to make purchases within a category to allow for more effective campaign planning and activation.

  

* Credit Risk products are a new suite of APIs and tooling to provide lenders real\-time access to KPIs and insights serving thousands of clients to make smarter risk decisions using Mastercard data.

  

Role  

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:  

  

* Participate in scoping, design and implementation of complex features.
* Delivery First time right scalable solution to push the boundaries of analytics applications.
* Design and implement intuitive, responsive UIs that allow issuers/acquirer's/fintech's to better understand data and analytics.
* Build and maintain analytics and data models to enable performant and scalable products.
* Ensure a high\-quality code base by writing and reviewing performant, well\-tested code.
* Mentor junior software engineers and teammates.
* Drive innovative improvements to team development processes.
* Partner with Product Managers and Customer Experience Designers to develop a deep understanding of users and use cases and apply that knowledge to scoping and building new modules and features.
* Collaborate across teams with exceptional peers who are passionate about what they do.

  

All about you / Ideal Candidate Qualifications  

  

* 8\+ years of full stack engineering experience in an agile production environment.
* Experience in design and implementation of complex features in full\-stack applications.


\- Experience working with cross regional Product \- Tech Team's.  

* Strong technologist eager to learn new technologies and frameworks.
* Proficiency with Java , Spring Boot , JPA , React, Redux, Typescript,
* Good to have .NET/C\# and Python.
* Solid experience with RESTful APIs and JSON/SOAP based API.
* Experience with SQL, Multi\-threading, Message Queuing \& Distributed Systems.
* Experience with Design Patterns.
* Expertise in Nunit/Junit or other automated unit testing frameworks.


Knowledge of Splunk or other alerting and monitoring solutions.  

* Fluent in the use of Git, Jenkins.
* Knowledge of cloud native development such as cloud foundry, AWS, etc.
* Customer\-centric development approach.
* Passion for analytical / quantitative problem solving.
* Ability to identify and implement improvements to team development processes.
* Strong collaboration skills with experience collaborating across many people, roles, and geographies.
* Motivation, creativity, self\-direction, and desire to thrive on small project teams.
* Superior academic record with a degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location:** Helsinki, Finland (Hybrid)

**Department:** Software development

**Type:** Full\-time

**Application deadline:** October 13, 2026

 **Are you ready to build the software that helps medical professionals harness the power of AI? Aiforia is transforming the world of tissue diagnostics and medical image analysis. We equip pathologists and scientists with deep learning AI to improve efficiency and consistency across clinical histopathology of cancer.**

**Our mission is to provide high\-quality, AI\-assisted solutions that enable personalized and democratized care for patients. To help us achieve this, we are looking for a driven Software Engineer to build and improve the products that bring our AI to clinical and research users.**

### **Role and responsibilities**


As a core member of our engineering team, you will work across the full stack, from back\-end services to the web applications our customers use every day. You will help expand Aiforia's platform and keep our existing products robust and reliable.

**Your key tasks will include:**

* Architecture and design: Design scalable, robust solutions across the stack, from back\-end services and APIs to user\-facing web features.
* Software implementation: Develop, write, and optimize production\-level code across the stack.
* AI tooling and context: Write and maintain the specifications, repository context, and prompts that make AI workflows possible.
* Quality assurance: Ensure high standards of code quality and reliability through code reviews, unit tests, and validation protocols.
* Technical documentation: Write and maintain clear, accurate technical documentation to support development, regulatory compliance, and cross\-team collaboration.
* Product maintenance: Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain existing products to ensure seamless performance for our users in clinical and research settings.

### **Who we are looking for**

The ideal candidate is a versatila engineer who is comfortable moving between back\-end front\-end work. You write clean dove, care about the end user, and thrive in a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
  

  

**Requirements:**

* Educational background: BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Experience: 3\+ years of relevant industry experience in full\-stack or software engineering.
* Technical skills: Strong programming skills and hands\-on experience building and deploying web applications and back\-end services in production.
* Communication: Excellent teamwork and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
* AI\-assisted development: Daily hands\-on use of AI coding tools in production work. You can explain the role of agents and context in the development workflow, and how you verify the result.

**What gives you an edge:**

* Experience and knowledge of image analysis and AI model building, and the workflows associated with them, including data management, verification metrics, and validation.
* Experience building and evolving an AI harness: the infrastructure around the development process that lets agents operate as independent actors across the delivery lifecycle.
* Experience improving how a team adopts AI coding tools: shared context, execution loops, and safety boundaries.
* Experience with our core stack: C\#/.NET.
* Experience with modern front\-end frameworks (e.g. React, Angular, TypeScript).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, databases, and cloud computing platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
* Previous experience working with medical devices, healthcare data, or within regulated environments (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA).

### **What we offer**

* Innovation: A chance to work at the forefront of medical AI technologies and make a real impact on patient care.
* Culture: Join a supportive, enthusiastic, and multidisciplinary team of experts who are passionate about what they do.
* Growth: Real opportunities for professional and career development in one of the fastest\-growing sectors of health tech.

### **Location**


Helsinki, Finland.


We offer a hybrid work model that provides flexibility for your daily life. However, we hope that you will work primarily from our office during the initial stage of your employment. This ensures you receive the best possible support, a smooth onboarding experience, and the opportunity to truly get to know your team from day one.


Please note: We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.

### **How to apply**


Are you the person we are looking for? Please, send your application by October 13, 2026 through careers.aiforia.com.

* For data privacy reasons, we only accept applications submitted via the portal.
* Please include a portfolio or work samples showcasing your design process and past projects.
* Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis prior to the deadline, so please submit yours as soon as possible.


Before you apply: Please read Aiforia's Privacy Policy for Job Applicants before submitting your application.


Aiforia is committed to creating an environment of inclusivity in which all voices and individuals are heard. We strive toward this by providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

jobs.title: People and Project Manager - for AI-assisted diagnostic medical software
jobs.description:
In 3Shape we work to improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients by providing innovative scanners and advanced software, tied together in collaborative workflows for the global community of dental professionals worldwide. We are using AI and machine learning methods for analyzing large amounts of medical (dentistry) data – pushing a field which traditionally has looked at 2D images towards 3D scan data.

**The product**


TRIOS Dx offers AI\-assisted dental diagnostic aid tools for monitoring oral health conditions and assessing changes in teeth and gingiva. By analyzing a 3D scan TRIOS Dx assists in diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque.


TRIOS Dx was made public and available to end users last year. We are now in a phase where we listen to market feedback and improve the product. We also plan to add new and existing functionality to it over the next many years.

**The position**


We are looking for a skilled People \& Project Manager for the AI team currently responsible for the AI’s diagnosing Caries, Tooth Wear, Gingival recession, and Plaque. You will be driving end\-to\-end delivery of innovative AI solutions and will during this play a key role in ensuring we use state\-of\-the\-art AI solutions, have the right data for AI development, and have thorough and efficient documentation required to get AP approved for use in a Medical Device software. Your main tasks include:

* Build, coach, and develop the team, cultivating an environment where people can do the best work of their lives.
* Lead your team through the full product lifecycle \- from ideation and development to deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on customer feedback.
* Ensure the team have clear ownership of domains, responsibilities, and deliverables.


You will be collaborating with various professionals such as application developers, AI developers, QA, RA, Product Management, and a Clinical Research team of dental professionals.

**Your profile**


We are looking for candidates with a good understanding of the AI and AI development. You may have experience from related positions, and you have a relevant education.

* Master’s degree or a PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, Engineering or a related field
* 2\+ years of leadership experience managing and growing engineering teams.
* Proven experience with Machine Learning (e.g. deep neural networks, supervised and unsupervised learning), preferably within image processing or processing of 3D data
* Solid software development skills, preferably in Python and C\#
* Mindset for quality, flexibility, creativity, emerging technologies


In our search for a new colleague, we always look for people with a cross\-disciplinary and open mindset. Through cooperation with program managers, project managers, developers, testers, and Regulatory Affair specialists; you will get an in\-depth understanding of all aspects of medical software development and use this to enable further growth and success.

**Get in touch now!**


Please do not hesitate to apply as soon for this exciting opportunity at one of Denmark’s most successful and fastest\-growing high\-tech companies, as applications will be processed continuously. The deadline for application is **10\. October**. We look forward to hearing from you.


We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About us**


3Shape started with a simple idea \- to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000\+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award\-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday \#lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

jobs.title: IT Operations Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the role**
------------------


The ICT Operations Support Engineer is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration and operational support of the client's ICT environment. The role focuses on service request management, IT administration, vendor coordination, user support, and operational governance to ensure ICT services are delivered effectively, securely, and in compliance with Whole\-of\-Government (WOG) standards.


A key responsibility of this role is to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of ICT service requests, ensuring requests are accurately raised, tracked, fulfilled, and verified before closure.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**ICT Operations \& Service Request Management**


* Raise, track, and manage ICT service requests, incidents, and operational support activities.
* Coordinate with government agencies, managed service providers, and vendors to fulfil requests within agreed SLAs.
* Review and validate service request submissions, approvals, and fulfilment evidence.
* Monitor request backlog, follow up on outstanding requests, and escalate service delivery issues where necessary.
* Maintain accurate records and audit trails for operational activities.

**IT Administration \& User Support**


* Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, and Intune.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and access management processes.
* Manage user accounts, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, licenses, and security groups.
* Coordinate endpoint provisioning, software installation, and workplace technology support.

**Vendor \& Service Delivery Management**


* Act as the liaison between the client and ICT service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and KPIs.
* Review service reports and validate completed work before acceptance.
* Participate in operational and service review meetings.

**Governance, Security \& Compliance**


* Support ICT governance, audit, risk management, and cybersecurity activities.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and support compliance exercises.
* Ensure ICT processes and documentation remain current and audit\-ready.

**Asset \& Operations Support**


* Maintain ICT asset inventory and software license records.
* Support asset verification, refresh, replacement, and disposal activities.
* Assist in incident management, problem management, and operational reporting.
**Requirements**
----------------


**Qualifications**


* Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

**Experience**


* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT operations, IT administration, service management, or infrastructure support.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and workplace technologies.
* Experience working with vendors and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with IT service management processes and tools.

**Preferred Experience**


* Experience working within the Singapore Government ICT environment.
* Familiarity with WOG ICT processes, governance, and support models.
* Experience using Government ICT support portals such as:
* + ITSM Portal
	+ SGMail Administration Portal
	+ EUSS Portal
* Experience supporting user provisioning, access management, email administration, and workplace technology services.

**Key Competencies**


* IT Administration
* Service Request Management
* Vendor Coordination
* Customer Service Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Operational Governance and Compliance
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**


Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.


As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:


**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.


**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.


**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020**.**


Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.


Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

* Experience with secure coding and vulnerability assessments across common web and mobile technologies.

* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex security requirements into practical advice

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


The Senior Engineer will drive Collins Aerospace’s transition toward highly automated, autonomous, and digitally connected manufacturing across multi sites under Singapore Operations . This includes robotics, machining automation, material\-handling systems, machine vision, factory systems integration. The role blends deep automation expertise, strong OT/IT integration capability to realize Collins’ Lights\-Out Manufacturing and Factory of the Future aspirations.


Roles \& Responsibilities


1\. Automation \& Robotics System Architecture


Lead design and deployment of robotics and automation systems for CNC machining, machine tending, material handling, inspection, and finishing.  

Develop process sequences, cycle\-time models, EOAT designs, and automation fixtures tailored to aerospace machining requirements.  

Integrate machine vision, sensing, and AI\-assisted inspection into robotic workflows for precision manufacturing.  

2\. Controls, Software \& Factory Systems Integration


Develop PLC/PC\-based control systems, robot programs (ABB/Fanuc/KUKA/UR), motion control logic, and HMI interfaces.  

Implement industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, REST) to integrate automation with CNCs, sensors, MES, SCADA, IIoT platforms, and enterprise systems.  

Conduct virtual commissioning, simulation, and system validation using digital engineering tools.  

3\. Factory Systems Engineering \& OT/IT Integration


Lead end\-to\-end integration of automation with:  

CNC machining centers  

MES \& ERP  

SCADA \& historian systems  

Tool management \& traceability systems  

Quality and inspection databases  

Develop high\-availability automation networks with strong data integrity, redundancy, and cybersecurity compliance.  

Architect scalable, modular automation platforms for autonomous cells, flexible machining systems, and Seletar Factory of the Future.  

4\. Project Leadership \& Vendor Management


Define SORs, specifications, layouts, acceptance test plans, budgets, and lifecycle plans for automation initiatives.  

Lead multi\-site implementation with strong governance, risk management, and adherence to safety standards (ISO 10218, ISO 13849, IEC 61508\).  

Evaluate commercial proposals, manage suppliers, and drive cost\-effective adoption of advanced manufacturing technologies.

  

Qualifications \& Skills


Education


Bachelor’s or Master’s in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related disciplines.  

Technical Expertise


5 \-10 years in robotics, automation, machining automation, and factory systems integration.  

Strong experience with CNC machining processes, robotic machine tending, vision systems, and aerospace precision manufacturing.  

Proficiency in controls engineering, PLC/PC programming, robot programming (ABB/Fanuc/KUKA/UR), and OT industrial networks.  

Digital \& Data Skills


Experience with MES/SCADA/IIoT platforms, OPC UA servers, MQTT, and machine connectivity frameworks.  

Proficiency in SQL, Python, and scripting for data processing, systems integration, and automated workflows.  

Experience with simulation and digital twin tools such as Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, Plant Simulation, or FlexSim.  

Software \& Application Skills


Skilled in automation\-oriented programming languages (Python, C\+\+, C\#, Java).  

Leadership \& Project Skills


5\+ years managing automation or capital projects; PMP/Prince2 certification advantageous.  

Strong competency in technology insertion, NPI automation readiness, factory redesign, and process revalidation.  

Excellent communication and stakeholder management across engineering, operations, quality, and digital technology teams.  

Additional Desired Skills


Familiarity with AS9100, APQP/PPAP, and aerospace manufacturing quality systems.  

Experience with cybersecurity for OT/automation networks.  

Strong capability in structured problem solving (6σ, DMAIC, FMEA).

##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience

Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 48,000 employees in 45 attractive markets – across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East \& Africa. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to roofing and walling – powered by premium brands including ECOPlanet, ECOPact, and ECOCycle®. Find out more at www.holcim.com


**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. We are driving circular construction as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.

  

Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

Support the Holcim Group and provide advanced electrical and automation engineering support for greenfield and brownfield plants across all project phases (definition, planning, and execution) as our **Electrical and Automation Engineer based in Zug Switzerland**. This role focuses on industrial CAPEX projects in Cement and Geocycle operations globally as well as large\-scale Carbon Capture, Utilization, and Storage (CCUS) initiatives

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

**Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)**  

* Drive a strong safety culture across all engineering activities, integrating "Safety in Design" and "Safety in Construction" principles.

* Ensure full compliance with Group HSE standards, security policies, and technical regulations across all assigned projects.

**Project Conceptualization \& Feasibility**  

* Develop robust, safe, and cost\-effective electrical and automation engineering concepts for business cases, feasibility studies, and tender packages.

* Analyse plant KPIs to assist CAPEX Project Managers in establishing accurate CAPEX/OPEX estimates and production targets.

* Evaluate tender submissions to identify technically sound, commercially optimal solutions.

**Detailed Engineering \& Quality Control**  

* Review detailed design documentation to ensure compliance with Group standards, safety requirements, maintainability, durability, and cost efficiency.

* Oversee quality control, technical inspections, and execution of electrical and automation packages during project implementation.

* Provide targeted, high\-value technical support during the commissioning and performance\-testing phases.

**Supplier Management \& Technical Governance**  

* Qualify global suppliers for electrical systems, power distribution, and drive technologies, maintaining a strong understanding of market capabilities.

* Develop and continuously refine standard design criteria, engineering tools (e.g., eDM, IBS), and technical best practices across the organization.

* Represent the discipline in knowledge\-sharing platforms and cross\-functional technical roundtables.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management**  

* Simultaneously manage electrical and automation deliverables across multiple concurrent projects based on priority.

* Collaborate effectively within diverse, multicultural, and multidisciplinary engineering teams across international locations.

**Your Profile**

  

* **Education:** University degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

* **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of hands\-on experience in industrial CAPEX project engineering (Cement, Heavy Industry, or Process Engineering preferred).

### **Technical \& Functional Skills**

  

* Deep knowledge of international electrical and automation engineering standards, tools, and methodologies.

* Proven experience in large\-scale CAPEX project execution, tender preparation, and vendor selection.

* Familiarity with heavy process industries (e.g., Cement, Energy, Carbon Capture).

  

  

### **Leadership \& Behavioural Competencies**

  

* **Technical Leadership:** Ability to influence stakeholders and establish credibility through technical expertise rather than direct authority.

* **Adaptability \& Resilience:** Comfortable working autonomously, managing shifting priorities, and conducting site assessments in remote or challenging environments.

* **Communication \& Negotiation:** Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge complex technical details with commercial and operational teams across global sites.

* **Mindset:** Highly analytical, rigorous, cost\-conscious, and open to continuous improvement and technical innovation.

### **Languages \& Mobility**

  

* **Languages:** Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) is required. Proficiency in additional core Group languages is a plus.

* **Mobility:** Willingness to travel frequently to project locations, supplier facilities, and construction sites worldwide, including regions with basic infrastructure or remote conditions.

  

  

  

**Benefits**

  

* Hybrid work contract
* Family Support: Subsidized child care and paid maternity/paternity leave
* Professional Growth: Company\-sponsored training and professional development.
* Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.
* Long\-service awards

* Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

*Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.*

  

*Important Notice: Holcim recruiters only contact candidates via official @\[holcim.com] email addresses. We do not use Gmail or any other non\-Holcim domains to conduct recruitment processes. Please verify the sender address before responding."*

jobs.title: IA Developer
jobs.description:
oin **Amaris Consulting** and work on **AI‑powered payroll and human resources management platforms** serving thousands of users worldwide. Be part of an international team, grow in an agile environment, and develop your career within a global group that values innovation, collaboration, and talent.


**Your mission \& impact**


As a **Senior Full‑Stack Engineer**, you will be a key member of the team building our **AI‑powered Payroll Operations platform**. You will work on a cutting‑edge intelligent assistant that automates and streamlines payroll workflows, enabling practitioners to manage payroll operations efficiently through a conversational AI experience. You will contribute across the full stack — from **micro frontends and web components**, through **REST APIs and relational databases**, to **cloud‑hosted AI agents** — and integrate with multiple enterprise payroll systems.


✅ **What we’re looking for**


* **7\+ years of experience** as a **Full‑Stack or Backend Engineer** working with **Python and/or .NET** in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong experience designing and building **Python‑based services**, ideally including **AI agents** or integrations with cloud AI platforms.
* Solid experience with **.NET Core** for building **RESTful APIs** and backend services.
* Experience with **modern frontend frameworks**, ideally **Angular**, and with **web components** (Stencil or similar) and **micro frontend architectures**.
* Strong knowledge of **relational databases** (preferably **SQL Server**): writing complex queries, understanding schemas, and integrating with existing data models.
* Experience with **infrastructure as code**, ideally **Terraform**, and cloud deployments (Azure/AWS/GCP).
* Solid understanding of **software architecture** and **distributed systems** (modularization, scalability, resilience).
* Experience integrating with or modernizing **legacy enterprise systems** without impacting existing functionality.
* Good understanding of **security best practices**: identity and access management, trust boundaries, idempotency, audit trails, PII protection, feature flags/kill switches.
* Hands‑on experience with **CI/CD tools** (Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) and use of **Git**.
* Strong knowledge of **software engineering best practices**: clean code, design patterns, testing, code review, documentation.
* **Professional level of English**, able to collaborate with international teams – your day‑to‑day work will be in English.

**What you will do**


* Design, build, and maintain **Python‑based AI agents** using modern agentic frameworks and cloud AI runtimes.
* Develop and maintain **.NET Core APIs** that act as downstream services for the AI agent layer.
* Build and integrate **Angular micro frontends** and **Stencil web components** into an existing enterprise shell application.
* Work with **SQL Server** databases: write and optimize queries, understand and evolve schemas, and integrate with existing **payroll data models**.
* Write and maintain **Terraform** code to define and manage cloud infrastructure for the platform.
* Integrate new **AI and automation capabilities** into **legacy enterprise payroll systems** without breaking existing functionality.
* Collaborate closely with **frontend, backend, AI, and infrastructure teams** to deliver end‑to‑end features.
* Implement and enforce **security and compliance best practices** across the stack (identity, auditability, PII redaction, feature flags, etc.).
* Contribute to **technical design documentation, READMEs, and the team knowledge base**, helping to spread best practices and onboard new team members.

**Your mindset \& soft skills**


* Strong **problem‑solving** skills and **analytical thinking**, with the ability to understand complex business and technical domains (payroll, HR, compliance).
* Excellent **communication skills** and ability to work in **multidisciplinary teams** (engineering, architecture, product, operations, business stakeholders).
* **Proactive attitude**, strong sense of **ownership**, and focus on **continuous improvement** and automation.
* Comfortable working in **agile environments** (Scrum, Kanban), participating in ceremonies and contributing to team rituals.

✨ **Nice to have**


* Experience in **financial services, payroll, HR tech** or other **highly regulated sectors**.
* Experience with **event‑driven architectures** and **messaging systems** (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
* Experience with **DevSecOps tools** (SAST, DAST, dependency analysis, secrets management).
* Familiarity with **observability and reliability practices** (monitoring, logging, alerting, SRE concepts).
* Experience with **API gateways, service mesh**, or **service discovery** tools.

**Why join us?**


* **Career growth:** 70% of our senior leaders started in junior positions.
* **Continuous learning:** access to our Technology Academy, Udemy courses, webinars, and company‑funded certifications.
* **Flexibility:** remote work options, flexible working policies, and social benefits (meal vouchers, transport, childcare support, private health insurance, etc.).
* **Well‑being:** our **WeCare** program supports employees in critical situations.
* **Personal development:** annual training budget to boost both your hard and soft skills.

  

**Who are we?**
---------------


**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System \& Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success.
  

  

At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like:
  

  

**Brief Call**: Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you!
  

  

**Interviews** (the average number of interviews is 3 \- the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities!
  

  

**Case study**: Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem\-solving scenario, etc.
  

  

As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience.
  

We look forward to meeting you!

* Arquitecturas cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Privada OpenStack e híbridas
* Arquitecturas de seguridad End\-to\-End: Zero Trust, Gestión de identidad...
* APIs y comunicaciones: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: Clean Code, SOLID, TDD
* Bases de datos: SQL, NoSQL

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET (AI & Parity Focus)
jobs.description:
As Hungary's most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad's representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.  

DT\-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019\. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.  

  

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution
  

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well\-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next\-generation, AI\-augmented, and cloud\-native software landscape.
  

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it\-ensuring sovereignty, high\-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.
  

Our Engineering Philosophy
  

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:
  

* AI\-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting\-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
* Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence\-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
* The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk\-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
* High\-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission  

To build the automated safety net that makes our modernization efforts possible. You will ensure that as we evolve the Internal Application Landscape, we maintain absolute functional parity and prevent any regressions in our mission\-critical business logic.
  

Role Focus  

This role focuses on building scalable automation frameworks and implementing AI\-driven testing strategies. You will verify that modernized components produce identical business outcomes to the legacy systems they replace, using both traditional and AI\-augmented testing techniques.
  

Key Responsibilities
  

* Automated Regression \& Parity Testing: Design and maintain comprehensive automated regression suites to protect legacy functionality and verify functional parity during migration.
* AI\-Augmented Testing: Leverage AI\-powered tools for automated test generation, self\-healing test scripts, and intelligent visual regression testing.
* Framework Development: Build and optimize scalable automation frameworks (UI, API, and Integration levels) specifically tailored for .NET and modern cloud\-native environments.
* Continuous Testing (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into DevOps pipelines (GitLab/GitHub/Jenkins) to provide immediate, high\-confidence feedback.
* API \& Integration Testing: Validate complex data flows and integrations between legacy monoliths and new, modern services.
* Collaboration: Work side\-by\-side with Developers and Architects to identify "testable" areas in legacy code and advocate for improved testability

**Candidate Requirements:**


* Experience: 5\+ years in automated software testing, with a strong background in software engineering/SDET.
* Automation Mastery: Proficiency with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, and API testing frameworks (RestSharp, etc.).
* AI/Modern Testing: Hands\-on familiarity with AI coding/testing assistants and the ability to implement automated regression strategies in complex environments.
* Programming Proficiency: Strong coding skills in C\# to build and maintain sophisticated test automation code.
* Analytical Rigor: A detective mindset with the ability to translate undocumented legacy behaviors into precise, automated test scenarios

\#LI\-REMOTE

new_jobs.title: junior mechanical engineer
new_jobs.description:
Als startende mechanical engineer begrijpen we dat je graag veel ervaring wilt opdoen en wilt ontdekken waar je het liefst mee bezig bent. Onder begeleiding van een lead engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, berekenen en construeren van (complexe) machines en producten waarbij de focus ligt op het volledig productierijp maken van mechanische (deel)concepten.


**WIE BEN JIJ?*** een hbo\- of wo\-opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica of soortgelijk
* bekend met 3D\-tekenpakketten zoals SolidWorks, Inventor, Creo of NX
* woonachtig in Nederland
* goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (minimaal C1\)
* nieuwsgierig, zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht.

**WAT BIEDEN WIJ JOU?*** een vaste baan van 32 of 40 uur
* een bruto maandsalaris binnen de range van € 2900 \- € 3500,\- per maand op basis van een 40\-urige werkweek (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring)
* 24 vakantiedagen. 6,5 adv\-dagen en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks tot 6,5 verlofdagen bij te kopen
* een uitgebreide onkostenvergoeding of auto van de zaak
* een pensioenregeling en diverse voordelige verzekeringen
* uitgebreide ontwikkelingstrajecten en doorgroeimogelijkheden
* moderne kantoren en werkplekken
* veel extra activiteiten, zoals een jaarlijks eindejaarsfeest, kwartaalbijeenkomsten en een actieve personeelsvereniging.

**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


Als mechanical engineer werk je, onder begeleiding van een lead engineer, gedetailleerde tekeningen uit (hoofdzakelijk van machines en systemen). Je denkt actief mee over de ontwerpfase. Bij het uitwerken van het ontwerp houd je rekening met de geldende normen op het gebied van veiligheid en kwaliteit. Wij hebben een inwerktraject waarbij je kennis maakt met onze organisatie en de manier van werken. Doordat je aan verschillende projecten werkt van machinebouwers en productiebedrijven in verschillende branches, kan jij je op jouw eigen tempo ontwikkelen tot de mechanical engineer die je wilt zijn/worden. Je ziet door het projectmatig werken iedere keer resultaat van je werk en raakt door de afwisseling niet verveeld. Hierdoor kan je op een prettige manier uitvinden wat het is dat je graag doet, waar je goed in bent en hoe jij je verder wilt ontwikkelen.

**Wij zijn TCPM**
-----------------

#### **Wij zijn TCPM**


We love engineering. Als ingenieurs en adviseurs vinden wij ons vak gewoon het mooiste dat er is. Daarom blijven we onszelf dag in dag uit ontwikkelen, verbreden we onze vakkennis en blijven we verkennen. Hierdoor weten wij alles van onze expertises: engineering, projectmanagement en industriële veiligheid. En we zijn niet snel tevreden. Kan het nog net iets beter, sterker, handiger of slimmer? Dan gaan we ervoor!


#### **Zo leveren we altijd perfect maatwerk**


Dat kan omdat we intensief samenwerken met onze opdrachtgevers. Zij kennen ons en wij kennen hen. Door en door. Niet voor niets vormen we voor hen al ruim 30 jaar de stabiele factor en zijn we uitgegroeid tot een onafhankelijk ingenieurs\- en adviesbureau met meer dan 200 medewerkers en 5 kantoren in Nederland.

new_jobs.title: Director, Value Engineering (DACH) - CPG/Retail
new_jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**About Celonis**
-----------------



Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI\-driven processes.



The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and operational intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand—turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. By providing the essential business context that AI agents and tools need to act effectively, Celonis makes AI truly enterprise\-ready.



Industry\-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global partner ecosystem to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together to achieve transformational outcomes. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, Celonis operates globally with over 20 offices worldwide.


**About the Role**
------------------



Based at our global headquarters in **Munich**, as a **Value Engineering Manager / Director** for **CPG \& Retail**, you will hold full operational and leadership responsibility specifically for the **CPG \& Retail segment across the DACH region**. In this role, you will lead a dedicated, high\-performing team of 6–7 Value Engineers operating at the intersection of process transformation, executive consulting, and AI\-driven product execution, driving the end\-to\-end customer value journey and accelerating enterprise AI adoption across major retail and consumer goods brands.



In this role, you will serve as a player\-coach, actively guiding, coaching, and developing a talented, high\-potential team with diverse backgrounds spanning supply chain, procurement, management consulting, and retail operations. This role offers tremendous growth potential as you both develop and learn alongside top\-tier talent, while serving as a trusted advisor to C\-level executives at major enterprise accounts.


**What Sets Our Patch Apart**
-----------------------------



The DACH CPG \& Retail patch represents some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands, retail giants, and mobility innovators. Our portfolio includes category leaders such as Aldi Süd, adidas AG, Zalando SE, Schwarz Digits IT KG, MediaMarktSaturn, and Sixt SE.



As our DACH CPG \& Retail customers navigate complex global supply chains, omnichannel fulfillment challenges, and the rapid rise of Process Intelligence and Agentic AI, you will engage directly—in both German and English—with vocal customer champions, C\-level decision\-makers, and pioneering thought leaders shaping the future of retail and consumer goods innovation.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* **Drive Business Outcomes \& Account Growth:** Take full ownership of ARR targets, renewal forecasts, and net retention across the DACH CPG \& Retail sector. Ensure high forecasting accuracy and steer accounts toward tangible, realized value.
* **People Leadership \& Coaching:** Recruit, onboard, lead, and mentor a team of 6–7 Munich\-based Value Engineers. Maintain high standards through proactive coaching, performance management, and career progression planning.
* **Executive Advisory \& Player\-Coach:** Serve as a Celonis Executive Sponsor on critical DACH deals. Join your team in the field to lead high\-impact executive meetings, dry runs, value sprints, and strategic transformation workshops.
* **Enterprise AI Champion:** Partner with customer executives to position Celonis as the foundation for modern process intelligence, digital operational excellence, and next\-generation Agentic AI adoption using our Context Model and Digital Twin capabilities.
* **Ecosystem \& Partner Strategy:** Cultivate executive\-level relationships across regional partner networks, services teams, and account executives to align CPG and retail customer strategies with Celonis AI solutions.
* **Thought Leadership:** Standardize and scale best practices, reusable solution blueprints, and CPG/Retail industry\-specific frameworks internally and across external customer communities.

**Leadership Behaviors We Value**
---------------------------------


* **Deliver Business Outcomes:** Focus on top\- and bottom\-line impact, maintaining green customer health and expanding retention across new logos and key enterprise accounts.
* **Motivate, Develop \& Nurture Talent:** Build an inclusive, high\-trust environment that attracts top\-tier external talent, retains top performers, accelerates individual growth, and addresses underperformance early.
* **Lead by Example:** Embody the "player/coach" mentality, maintaining an active on\-site presence with priority accounts and upholding strict quality standards across all engagements.
* **Think BIG, Be BOLD:** Champion an entrepreneurial growth mindset by expanding your internal/external network, spearheading new go\-to\-market motions, and positioning Celonis as an essential innovation driver in retail and consumer goods.

**Qualifications \& Scope**
---------------------------


* **Language Skills:** Native or business\-fluent **German** (spoken and written) and fluent **English** are required to interface effectively with executive decision\-makers across the DACH market.
* **Location Presence:** Based in or willing to relocate to **Munich**, with willingness to travel to customer sites across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland as needed.
* **Proven Leadership Experience:** Track record leading pre\-sales, management consulting, or value engineering teams within Enterprise SaaS, Enterprise AI, or Management Consulting.
* **Domain Expertise:** Deep domain familiarity with supply chain, procurement, fulfillment, and operational processes within the CPG \& Retail industries.
* **People Management:** Demonstrated ability to directly manage or mentor a team of 6–7 high\-performing individual contributors, with a strong passion for team coaching and talent development.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong business acumen with experience owning ACV, net retention, and renewal pipeline metrics.
* **Executive Presence:** Outstanding executive presence with a proven track record of building C\-level relationships across global brands and regional retail leaders.

  

  

**What Celonis can offer you:**


* **Pioneer Innovation:** Work with the leading, award\-winning process mining technology, shaping the future of business.
* **Accelerate Your Growth:** Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* **Receive Exceptional Benefits:** Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.

* **Collaborate Globally:** Join a dynamic, international team of talented individuals.
* **Empowered Environment:** Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

  

  

**About Us:**  

Celonis makes processes work for people, companies and the planet. The Celonis Process Intelligence Platform uses industry\-leading process mining and AI technology and augments it with business context to give customers a living digital twin of their business operation. It's system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric)
new_jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions

Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment

Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.

Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues

Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD

experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineer (Full-Stack)
new_jobs.description:
The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.


Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.


Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.


The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy \& Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all\-to\-all trading platform.


The Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,300 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.


**Role Overview:**

TP ICAP has Partnered with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to build the Next Generation of the Fusion Platform and make it Global Market Infrastructure. This role will be working in a new team to build out a new Platform based on the latest technology and architecture. You will be working alongside AWS and learning from the best. As a Senior Engineer you will be responsible for demonstrating excellent technical competencies with a desire to improve and mentor junior members of the team. You will take responsibility for your assigned work by taking ownership of the design, development testing and deployment of software across the team, and work closely with the Principal Engineer, Architects and Leads to ensure the successful deployment into production environments.


**Role Responsibilities:**

* Be able to drive engineering improvements whilst communicating principles behind your work to other team members and the wider organisation.
* Be proactive in supporting the team’s engagement in a well\-defined SDLC that supports planning, prioritisation and delivery needs.
* Support the team in leading conversations around estimation by leveraging previous experience, challenging requirements and fostering potential solutions.
* Lead conversations around software systems to enable meaningful conversations about wider system architecture with Engineers.
* Evolve systems towards target state architecture by refactoring and prioritisation of deliveries.

**Experience/Competencies**

Essential:


* Demonstrable industry experience as a Full Stack or Front/Backend Engineer in Typescript in a professional environment.
* Front\-end skills



	+ Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, and Typescript
	+ Proficient in React, Redux, ReactQuery
	+ Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks \- React
	+ Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
	+ Understanding of cross\-browser compatibility
	+ Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL and Websockets
	+ Experience with CSS pre\-processors e.g. Tailwind
* Back\-end skills



	+ Proficiency in backend programming languages (Typescript and/or other OOP language such as c\#/Java)
	+ Strong database knowledge (SQL and NoSQL)
	+ Proficiency with RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs and Websockets
	+ Experience with microservices architecture
	+ Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
	+ Experience with Terraform
	+ Experience with automated testing
	+ Experience with AWS (AWS Lambda, AWS Fargate, Amazon API Gateway, AWS AppSync)
* Worked within an Agile Cross\-functional delivery team.
* Developing well tested software into low latency event driven production environments.
* Full software development lifecycle in a technical role.
* Pub/Sub patterns with Messaging technologies (such as SOLACE/AMQP)
* Worked within a technical platform team, delivering reusable services across multiple agile projects.
* Microservice Architecture.
* Containerization.
* Maintaining code quality with Unit, Integration and e2e testing.
* AWS cloud ecosystem and the AWS CLI (or industry equivalent).
* Linux shell or Windows PowerShell.
* CI and CD flows within an enterprise environment. Continuous Delivery
* Agile tooling to support team delivery, such as JIRA and other project management systems.
* Open to innovative ideas/ experiences and ability to create new ideas, approaches or insights.
* Seeks opportunities for improvements.
* Demonstrates high levels of energy in seeking out and achieving new goals.
* Can work with BA’s/PO’s to demystify ambiguity, handle challenge, and is comfortable to challenge team mates constructively.
* Adapts communication style to suit audience.
* Works ethically and shows respect for both professional and company values.
* Excellent attention to detail, highly organised with a proactive approach.
* Strong analytical ability and innovative problem solving skills.
* Software Design Patterns.
* Source control (Git).

Desired:


* OOP \\ SOLID Principles.
* Demonstrable experience of C\# (.Net 8\+) in a professional environment.
* Contribution to open\-source projects.
* Experience of regulatory driven projects.
* Knowledge of Financial Markets, Systems and Over the Counter (OTC) products.

The Fusion Platform Team Builds, Owns and Runs it’s own services all the way through to Production. The services are used 24/5 by several teams. As part of a global team, there may be times when you are asked to assist with production incidents or support outside regular hours to maintain operational stability.


***Band \& Level – Manager, 6***

\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MID


**Not The Perfect Fit?**

Concerned that you may not meet the criteria precisely? At TP ICAP, we wholeheartedly believe in fostering inclusivity and cultivating a work environment where everyone can flourish, regardless of your personal or professional background. If you are enthusiastic about this role but find that your experience doesn't align perfectly with every aspect of the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be the ideal candidate for this position or another opportunity within our organisation. Our dedicated Talent Acquisition team is here to assist you in recognising how your unique skills and abilities can be a valuable contribution. Don't hesitate to take the leap and explore the possibilities. Your potential is what truly matters to us.


**Company Statement**

We know that the best innovation happens when diverse people with different perspectives and skills work together in an inclusive atmosphere. That's why we're building a culture where everyone plays a part in making people feel welcome, ready and willing to contribute. TP ICAP Accord \- our Employee Network \- is a central to this. As well as representing specific groups, TP ICAP Accord helps increase awareness, collaboration, shares best practice, and holds our firm to account for driving continuous cultural improvement.
