new_jobs.description:
At Ensono, our purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross\-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.



Developing impactful solutions is something we do together at Ensono because Ideas Start Here. Great things happen when many voices are heard, and people are supported to run with their ideas. On our teams, you will be backed by leaders with a passion for our business. This is a place where your ideas can Do Great Things.



We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business.



Adventure starts here. Here you will be a part of a team that encourages you to master your craft, ask tomorrow's questions today, and chart your path. Our Associates focus on client impact with curiosity and a feeling of relentless commitment.


**About the role and what you will be doing:**



As a Senior .NET Consultant at Ensono Digital, you will play a key delivery and technical leadership role within your project, operating as a trusted senior engineer who supports high\-quality outcomes while helping the team and client realise the business value of their cloud investment. You will typically support a Tech Lead or Lead Consultant, taking ownership of significant technical areas or sub\-systems within a larger solution. Working across the full project lifecycle, you will collaborate closely with Ensono Digital colleagues and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical designs and deliver modern, cloud\-native solutions using contemporary engineering practices. Beyond project delivery, you will contribute to Ensono Digital communities, share knowledge, and continuously develop your skills and career as a senior consultant.

  


**What** **you'll** **bring to Ensono Digital**



We are looking for experienced senior engineers who bring strong technical capability, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset. You will have experience delivering production‑grade systems and taking ownership of technical outcomes within complex projects.



You will bring experience and capability in areas such as:


* Developing high‑quality solutions using .NET (Core / modern .NET)
* Building and operating systems on cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
* Working with microservice and distributed architectures, understanding their benefits and trade‑offs
* Translating business requirements into well‑defined designs and sub‑system architectures
* Writing appropriate integration and end‑to‑end tests, using approaches such as BDD where appropriate
* Maintaining accountability for code quality, security, and engineering standards


You will demonstrate strong technical communication and problem‑solving skills, including:


* Clearly explaining the purpose of a solution and the reasoning behind design and technology choices to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
* Confidently resolving technical challenges within a complex delivery and taking responsibility for outcomes within your scope
* Contributing constructively to architectural discussions, discovery activities, and design reviews


You will also bring a modern developer mindset, including:


* Working effectively with AI‑assisted development tools to support productivity and learning, while applying professional judgment and remaining accountable for results
* Valuing clear specifications, documentation, and fast feedback loops as enablers of sustainable delivery
* Continuously improving your own skills and supporting the growth of others through collaboration and knowledge sharing


Above all, you will bring a professional, proactive approach, strong collaboration skills, and a genuine interest in delivering high‑quality outcomes for clients while growing as a senior consultant within Ensono Digital.


**Our benefits include**


* Highly competitive salary
* Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual Presidents Club
* Company equity incentive plan
* 27 days annual leave \+ plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 with length of service)
* ½ day leave for your birthday
* Sabbatical options at 5\-years \& 10\-years' service
* 5 days study leave
* 1 day charity leave to work for a charity of your choice
* Competitive pension
* Private healthcare for you and your family
* Enhanced parental leaves
* Life and income protection
* Payroll giving to your favorite charity
* Coaching \& mentoring opportunities
* Additional perks such as discounted gym membership, cycle scheme, EAP and more!

* Hate speech or discriminatory behaviour
* Threats or acts of violence

Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

new_jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the role**
------------------


The ICT Operations Support Engineer is responsible for the day\-to\-day administration and operational support of the client's ICT environment. The role focuses on service request management, IT administration, vendor coordination, user support, and operational governance to ensure ICT services are delivered effectively, securely, and in compliance with Whole\-of\-Government (WOG) standards.


A key responsibility of this role is to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of ICT service requests, ensuring requests are accurately raised, tracked, fulfilled, and verified before closure.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


**ICT Operations \& Service Request Management**


* Raise, track, and manage ICT service requests, incidents, and operational support activities.
* Coordinate with government agencies, managed service providers, and vendors to fulfil requests within agreed SLAs.
* Review and validate service request submissions, approvals, and fulfilment evidence.
* Monitor request backlog, follow up on outstanding requests, and escalate service delivery issues where necessary.
* Maintain accurate records and audit trails for operational activities.

**IT Administration \& User Support**


* Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Entra ID, and Intune.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and access management processes.
* Manage user accounts, shared mailboxes, distribution lists, licenses, and security groups.
* Coordinate endpoint provisioning, software installation, and workplace technology support.

**Vendor \& Service Delivery Management**


* Act as the liaison between the client and ICT service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against SLAs and KPIs.
* Review service reports and validate completed work before acceptance.
* Participate in operational and service review meetings.

**Governance, Security \& Compliance**


* Support ICT governance, audit, risk management, and cybersecurity activities.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and support compliance exercises.
* Ensure ICT processes and documentation remain current and audit\-ready.

**Asset \& Operations Support**


* Maintain ICT asset inventory and software license records.
* Support asset verification, refresh, replacement, and disposal activities.
* Assist in incident management, problem management, and operational reporting.
**Requirements**
----------------


**Qualifications**


* Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

**Experience**


* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT operations, IT administration, service management, or infrastructure support.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 and workplace technologies.
* Experience working with vendors and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with IT service management processes and tools.

**Preferred Experience**


* Experience working within the Singapore Government ICT environment.
* Familiarity with WOG ICT processes, governance, and support models.
* Experience using Government ICT support portals such as:
* + ITSM Portal
	+ SGMail Administration Portal
	+ EUSS Portal
* Experience supporting user provisioning, access management, email administration, and workplace technology services.

**Key Competencies**


* IT Administration
* Service Request Management
* Vendor Coordination
* Customer Service Excellence
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Operational Governance and Compliance
* Communication \& Interpersonal Skills
**Let's talk about what's in it for you!**


Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self\-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.


As 'Architects of Positive Futures', Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:


**Diversity and Inclusion** \- we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.


**Digital inclusion** \- at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.


**Environmental Sustainability** \- Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious 'A list' for its commitment to the Net\-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by2020**.**


Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the **World's Most Ethical Companies** for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business. Embedded in our DNA, our seven values \- Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty \- have remained the same since company inception in 1967\. To see how we bring these values to life, click here to listen to some of our employee’s stories.


Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains.
